1332-peter-pan-in-kensington-gardens.title: Peter Pan In Kensington Gardens
1332-peter-pan-in-kensington-gardens.creator: J. M. Barrie
1332-peter-pan-in-kensington-gardens.description: A book by J. M. Barrie. remembered a youthful desire to return to the tree-tops, and with that memory came others, as that he had lain in bed planning to escape as soon as his mother was asleep, and how she had once caught him half-way up the chimney.

arxiv-1703-00232.title: Integrability, Quantization and Moduli Spaces of Curves This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Recent Advances in Quantum Integrable Systems. The full collection is available at http://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/RAQIS2016.html
arxiv-1703-00232.creator: Paolo ROSSI
arxiv-1703-00232.description: Abstract This paper has the purpose of presenting in an organic way a new approach to integrable ( 1 + 1 ) (1+1) -dimensional field systems and their systematic quantization emerging from intersection theory of the moduli space of stable algebraic curves and, in particular, cohomological field theories, Hodge classes and double ramification cycles.

arxiv-2007-01578.title: volesti : Volume Approximation and Sampling for Convex Polytopes in R
arxiv-2007-01578.creator: by Apostolos Chalkis, Vissarion Fisikopoulos
arxiv-2007-01578.description: Abstract Sampling from high dimensional distributions and volume approximation of convex bodies are fundamental operations that appear in optimization, finance, engineering, artificial intelligence and machine learning. In this paper we present volesti , an R package that provides efficient, scalable algorithms for volume estimation, uniform and Gaussian sampling from convex polytopes.

arxiv-2106-05545.title: Super-Resolution Image Reconstruction Based on Self-Calibrated Convolutional GAN
arxiv-2106-05545.creator: Yibo Guo, Haidi Wang, Yiming Fan, shunyao Li, and Mingliang Xu
arxiv-2106-05545.description: Abstract With the effective application of deep learning in computer vision, breakthroughs have been made in the research of super-resolution images reconstruction. However, many researches have pointed out that the insufficiency of the neural network extraction on image features may bring the deteriorating of newly reconstructed image.

arxiv-2112-08659.title: q-ary propelinear perfect codes from the regular subgroups of the G ​ A ​ ( r , q ) GA(r,q) and their ranks* Thanks: * This work was funded by the Russian Science Foundation under grant 22-21-00135, https://rscf.ru/en/project/22-21-00135/
arxiv-2112-08659.creator: Ivan Mogilnykh
arxiv-2112-08659.description: Abstract . We propose a new method of constructing q q -ary propelinear perfect codes. The approach utilizes permutations of the fixed length q q -ary vectors that arise from the automorphisms of the regular subgroups of the affine group.

arxiv-2302-02814.title: MixFormer: End-to-End Tracking with Iterative Mixed Attention
arxiv-2302-02814.creator: Yutao Cui, Cheng Jiang, Gangshan Wu, and Limin Wang
arxiv-2302-02814.description: Abstract Visual object tracking often employs a multi-stage pipeline of feature extraction, target information integration, and bounding box estimation. To simplify this pipeline and unify the process of feature extraction and target information integration, in this paper, we present a compact tracking framework, termed as MixFormer , built upon transformers.

arxiv-2304-04771.title: Instruction of my personal computing library
arxiv-2304-04771.creator: Tomohiro Oishi
arxiv-2304-04771.description: Abstract Abstract This document is prepared to introduce and explain how to use the computing library composed by T. Oishi. The main purpose of library is to perform numerical calculations in the nuclear physics. Its final version is expected to be published for educational and commercial purposes.

arxiv-2406-08727.title: Trade, Growth, and Product Innovation
arxiv-2406-08727.creator: Carlos Góes
arxiv-2406-08727.description: Abstract Can trade integration induce product innovation? I document that countries that joined the European Union (EU) started producing more product varieties, investing more in R&D, and trading more compared to candidate countries that did not join at a given horizon.

arxiv-2410-00937.title: UNIFORM BOUNDS ON S S -INTEGRAL PREPERIODIC POINTS FOR CHEBYSHEV polynomials Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification: Primary 37F10, Secondary 11G50, 11J71, 11J86. Keywords: Chebyshev polynomial; equidistribution; integral points; preperiodic points; The Arkelov-Zhang pairing; linear forms i
arxiv-2410-00937.creator: R. Padhy, S. S. Rout
arxiv-2410-00937.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by R. Padhy, S. S. Rout. Let K K be a number field with algebraic closure K ¯ \bar{K} , let S S be a finite set of places of K K containing the archimedean places, and let φ \varphi be Chebyshev polynomial. In this paper we prove uniformity results on the number of S S -integral preperiodic points relative to a non-preperiodic point β \beta , as β \beta varies over number fields of bounded degree.

arxiv-2410-05404.title: Error-Correcting Codes in TQFT on Multispheres
arxiv-2410-05404.creator: Rafael Chaves, Dmitry Melnikov, Marcos Neves, Luigy Pinto, Davide Poderini
arxiv-2410-05404.description: Abstract Topological quantum field theories (TQFT) encode quantum correlations in topological features of spaces. In this work, we leverage this feature to explore how information encoded in TQFTs can be stored and retrieved in the presence of local decoherence affecting its physical carriers. TQFT states’ inherent nonlocality, redundancy, and entanglement position them as natural error-correcting codes.

arxiv-2411-06163.title: Rotation quenches in trapped bosonic systems
arxiv-2411-06163.creator: Rhombik Roy, Sunayana Dutta, Ofir E. Alon
arxiv-2411-06163.description: Abstract The ground state properties of strongly rotating bosons confined in an asymmetric anharmonic potential exhibit a split density distribution. However, the out-of-equilibrium dynamics of this split structure remain largely unexplored. Given that rotation is responsible for the breakup of the bosonic cloud, we investigate the out-of-equilibrium dynamics by abruptly changing the rotation frequency.

arxiv-2501-01652.title: MIRAGE: Exploring How Large Language Models Perform in Complex Social Interactive Environments
arxiv-2501-01652.creator: Yin Cai, Zhouhong Gu, Zhaohan Du, Zheyu Ye, Shaosheng Cao, Yiqian Xu, Hongwei Feng, Ping Chen
arxiv-2501-01652.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in environmental perception, reasoning-based decision-making, and simulating complex human behaviors, particularly in interactive role-playing contexts. This paper introduces the Multiverse Interactive Role-play Ability General Evaluation (MIRAGE), a comprehensive framework designed to assess LLMs’ proficiency in portraying advanced human behaviors through murder mystery games.

arxiv-2505-06154.title: Institut de Physique Nucléaire, Atomique et de Spectroscopie, CESAM, University of Liège, B-4000 Liège, Belgium
arxiv-2505-06154.description: Abstract Coherent Generation and Protection of Anticoherent Spin States Jérôme Denis \star , Colin Read \dagger and John Martin \ddagger Abstract We report the first protocol specifically designed to generate anticoherent spin- j states at various orders. The protocol consists of cycles involving a rotation pulse about one axis, followed by a squeezing pulse along a perpendicular direction.

arxiv-2510-16838.title: Bayesian inference of the magnetic component of quark-gluon plasma
arxiv-2510-16838.creator: Yu Guo, Jinfeng Liao, Shuzhe Shi
arxiv-2510-16838.description: Abstract The chromo-magnetic monopoles (CMM), emergent topological excitations of non-Abelian gauge fields carrying chromo-magnetic charge, have long been postulated to play an important role in the vacuum confinement of quantum chromodynamics (QCD), the deconfinement transition at temperature T c ≈ 160 ​ MeV T_{c}\approx 160\rm MeV , as well as the strongly coupled nature of quark-gluon plasma (QGP).

nasa-tm-19630006262-the-effects-of-wing-.description: NASA technical report. Wing planform effect on static longitudinal aerodynamic characteristics of flat top hypersonic aircraft at transonic speeds

pmc-10571241.title: Biomarkers in Alzheimer’s disease: role in early and differential diagnosis and recognition of atypical variants
pmc-10571241.creator: Bruno Dubois, Christine A F von Arnim, Nerida Burnie, Sasha Bozeat, Jeffrey Cummings
pmc-10571241.description: BackgroundDevelopment of in vivo biomarkers has shifted the diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) from the later dementia stages of disease towards the earlier stages and has introduced the potential for pre-symptomatic diagnosis. The International Working Group recommends that AD diagnosis is restricted in the clinical setting to people with specific AD phenotypes and supportive biomarker findings.

pmc-11499087.title: Saturated fatty acids and total and CVD mortality in Norway: a prospective cohort study with up to 45 years of follow-up
pmc-11499087.creator: Erik Kristoffer Arnesen, Ida Laake, Marit B Veierød, Kjetil Retterstøl
pmc-11499087.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The contribution of dietary saturated fatty acids (SFA) to cardiovascular disease (CVD) and mortality remains debated after decades of research. Few previous studies had repeated dietary assessments and power to assess mortality. Evidence for individual SFA is limited. In this large population-based cohort study, we investigated associations between intake of total and individual SFA and risk of total and CVD mortality.

pmc-11637742.title: Are we there yet? CAR‐T therapy in multiple myeloma
pmc-11637742.creator: Eitan Mirvis, Reuben Benjamin
pmc-11637742.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryThe last few years have seen a revolution in cellular immunotherapies for multiple myeloma (MM) with novel antigen targets. The principle new target is B‐cell maturation antigen (BCMA). Autologous chimeric antigen receptor T‐cell (CAR‐T) therapy directed against BCMA was first approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and European Medicines Agency (EMA) in 2021, although approval by the National Institute for Health and Care Excellent (NICE) is awaited.

pmc-11656871.title: Machine learning-based prognostic model of lactylation-related genes for predicting prognosis and immune infiltration in patients with lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-11656871.creator: Mingjun Gao, Mengmeng Wang, Siding Zhou, Jiaqi Hou, Wenbo He, Yusheng Shu, Xiaolin Wang
pmc-11656871.description: BackgroundHistone lactylation is a novel epigenetic modification that is involved in a variety of critical biological regulations. However, the role of lactylation-related genes in lung adenocarcinoma has yet to be investigated.MethodsRNA-seq data and clinical information of LUAD were downloaded from TCGA and GEO datasets.

pmc-12453936.title: Fully Guided Implant Placement and Immediate Provisionalization in the Maxillary Aesthetic Zone Using Prefabricated Restorations
pmc-12453936.creator: Vincent J. J. Donker, Henny J. A. Meijer, Arjan Vissink, Gerry M. Raghoebar
pmc-12453936.description: Introduction: When replacing a single tooth in the aesthetic zone with an implant, alveolar ridge preservation is necessary in cases with extensive buccal bone defects. Prosthetically driven implant placement in the preserved ridge, followed by an immediate patient-specific temporary restoration, can be achieved with digital treatment planning.

pmc-12587725.title: In vitro fertilization-assisted pregnancy combined with high-intensity focused ultrasound treatment in patients with endometriosis and adenomyosis with successful pregnancy: a case report
pmc-12587725.creator: Qiuyue Wen, Yaping Ma, Jing Chen, Yuan Ou, Chunling Yao
pmc-12587725.description: BackgroundHigh-intensity focused ultrasound ablation has emerged as a noninvasive therapeutic option for adenomyosis of the uterus. We studied a female with infertility patient to explore the application of in vitro fertilization combined with high-intensity focused ultrasound treatment in patients with endometriosis complicated by adenomyosis.

pmc-12727732.title: Rational design of next-generation filovirus vaccines combining glycoprotein stabilization and nanoparticle display with glycan modification
pmc-12727732.creator: Yi-Zong Lee, Yi-Nan Zhang, Maddy L Newby, Garrett Ward, Keegan Braz Gomes, Sarah Auclair, Connor DesRoberts, Joel D Allen, Andrew B Ward, Robyn L Stanfield, Linling He, Max Crispin, Ian A Wilson, Jiang Zhu
pmc-12727732.description: Filoviruses pose a significant threat to human health due to frequent outbreaks and high mortality. Although two vector-based vaccines are available for Ebola virus, a broadly protective filovirus vaccine remains elusive. Here, we evaluate a general strategy for stabilizing glycoproteins (GP) from Ebola, Sudan, and Bundibugyo orthoebolaviruses, as well as Ravn orthomarburgvirus. A 3.

pmc-13115284.title: Primary Stability of Implants Inserted Using Different Osseodensification Systems in Low-Density Bone: An In Vitro Study
pmc-13115284.creator: André Luís Onodera, Alexandre Wanderley Alécio, Gustavo Batista Grolli Klein, Sheila Cortelli, Rogério de Lima Romeiro
pmc-13115284.description: Background/Objectives: It remains unclear which drilling strategy is most effective for maximizing mechanical stability in low-density bone and whether high insertion torque is determinative. The aim of this in vitro study was to compare the primary stability of implants placed using different drilling protocols—conventional (CV), undersized (US), and osseodensification (OD).

pmc-13681929.title: Rare multi - regional involvement in posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome with spinal cord involvement of a young hypertensive male: a case report
pmc-13681929.creator: Jingjing Dou, Yuxia Li, Xiangzhen Yuan, Hui Zhang
pmc-13681929.description: BackgroundPosterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) is an acute or subacute cerebral syndrome which primarily manifests as headache, encephalopathy, seizures, and visual disturbances in various combinations. PRES with spinal cord involvement (PRES-SCI) is extremely rare and considered to be a variant of PRES.Case presentationWe present a case of PRES-SCI where the patient primarily manifested with bilateral blurred vision.
